summary: The test contains a syntax error in the locator selector string and incorrectly treats Locator as an array for iteration, which will cause runtime errors and test failure.

issues.description: The locator selector string is missing a closing double quote after [data-test="product-3"].
issues.recommendation: Add the missing closing double quote to properly close the selector string.

issues.description: Locator is treated as an array and iterated with a for loop using count and nth, which is not recommended and can cause errors.
issues.recommendation: Use Locator methods like locator.nth(i) with await properly or use locator.all() with Promise.all to handle multiple elements safely.

recommendations: Fix the selector string syntax error by adding the missing closing quote.
Avoid treating Locator as an array; use Locator API methods correctly for iteration.
Ensure all asynchronous Playwright calls are awaited.
Keep test case ID 'MP-1' in the test title as required.
